title: Checking PA proofs inside arithmetic

based_on.title: An Introduction to Gödel's Theorems, second edition, corrected Logic Matters reprint

summary: Construct the actual PA proof checker and verify its record-building operations at arbitrary internal codes.
abstract: A proof checker can verify a particular finite proof without arithmetic having justified its use on arbitrary proof codes. We give certificates for all PA axioms, including induction with parameters, and follow the actual checker through its nineteen proof rules. Its graph gives a fixed arithmetic formula for proof acceptance. We then examine what happens when accepted proof records are combined: conclusions, assumptions, axiom certificates and fresh names must all match. Keeping those checks explicit explains how an argument valid in every PA model yields a PA derivation about the checker itself.
